tasks.label: Keil: 编译 (Build)
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& 'F:/keil5/Core/UV4/UV4.exe' -b '${workspaceFolder}/Project/5220-apm32.uvprojx' -j0 -o '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log'){ Write-Host '==== UV4 构建日志 ===='; Get-Content '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log' }; Write-Host ('==== UV4 退出码: ' + $code + '  (0/1=成功或有警告, 2=有错误) ===='); exit $code"

tasks.label: Keil: 全量重编译 (Rebuild All)
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& 'F:/keil5/Core/UV4/UV4.exe' -r '${workspaceFolder}/Project/5220-apm32.uvprojx' -j0 -o '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log'){ Write-Host '==== UV4 构建日志 ===='; Get-Content '${workspaceFolder}/Project/uv4_build.log' }; Write-Host ('==== UV4 退出码: ' + $code + '  (0/1=成功或有警告, 2=有错误) ===='); exit $code"
